Problem Statement:  Sort Words by Length Using Selection Sort

Write a program to sort a list of words based on their length using Selection Sort.
If two words have the same length, maintain lexicographic order.

Description

Input contains n words.

Sort by word length in ascending order.

If lengths match, compare alphabetically.

Input Format

First line: Integer n

Next n lines: One word per line

Output Format

Sorted list of words.
